lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p29 - Listen and point

details: Listen and point checks understanding of word and target sound. It shows they match what they hear to the right image.
Look for careful listening and correct pointing,

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Activity Book p73 - Point and Say

details: Point and Say  evaluates their knowledge of previously seen letters and images. Point shows they can identify the letter after hearing said it. Say checks their speaking and pron of said words and identifying word with that letter and sound
Look for  eye movement and clear pointing as Ss identify the letters. Listen for clear pronunciation of words.
